status: Research comparison, not library design or a change to scoring axes.
actual_work: Read cached complete relevant primary Results/Methods for YabA and YihI/Der; compared the controls and annotation boundaries. No assays or raw-data recomputation.

cases.observation: Selective DnaA- or DnaN-interaction loss disrupts localization/control; complementary variants restore both, with same-defect coexpression control.
cases.reconstructed_decision: Whole-gene deletion loses several relationships simultaneously. Ask whether preserving other interactions but removing one specific connection changes function, then whether complementary losses can repair together.
cases.allowed_conclusion: DnaA/DnaN connections contribute jointly to YabA initiation control.
cases.not_allowed: A specific DnaA ATPase mechanism is not established by this study.

cases.observation: Moderate YihI improves derT57I growth, but purified T57I shows no detectable activation or competition for YihI under tested conditions. Potassium alters stimulation of wild-type Der.
cases.reconstructed_decision: Ask if growth rescue reflects restoration of the proposed catalytic defect; compare mutant enzymology/binding, retaining assay conditions.
cases.allowed_conclusion: Phenotypic support does not establish catalytic repair; physiological contribution remains compatible with indirect compensation.
cases.not_allowed: Do not infer no interaction under every condition, or treat all Der alleles identically.

comparison_result: The assay label rescue does not define the inference. The same evidence operation can test joint causal requirements or compensation; a process must carry the biological relationship being tested and its competing explanations.
unresolved_modularity: Whether causal relationship and counterexample selection form separate composable slots still requires comparison across other cases.
